swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: MC33202DR2G is limited to 12 V max (13 V abs max, p.3) whereas NE5532DR supports up to 30 V (36 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS part on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (MC33202DR2G: IN=RR, OUT=RR vs NE5532DR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 5.5x (MC33202DR2G: 2.2 MHz p.4 vs NE5532DR: 12 MHz p.4); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 5x (MC33202DR2G: 1 V/µs p.4 vs NE5532DR: 5 V/µs p.4); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 3.3x (MC33202DR2G: 900 µA/ch p.4 vs NE5532DR: 3000 µA/ch p.4); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: MC33202DR2G has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (13 V, p.3) than NE5532DR (36 V, p.3); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 13 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 96% higher on MC33202DR2G (MC33202DR2G: 190 °C/W p.5 vs NE5532DR: 97 °C/W p.3); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: NE5532DR requires Vs,min >= 10 V (p.3) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (MC33202DR2G: -40..105 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to 105°C) vs NE5532DR: 0..70 °C Commercial (0°C to 70°C)); NE5532DR cold limit only 0 °C, NE5532DR hot limit only 70 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and NE5532DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because supply voltage Vs,max drops >=20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs; GBWP differs 5.5x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 2.2 MHz (p.4) vs 12 MHz (p.4), supply ceiling 12 V (p.1) vs 30 V (p.3), Vos 8 mV (p.3) vs 4 mV (p.4), Ib 3x gap (80000 vs 200000 pA), voltage noise 20 vs 5 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: MC33202DR2G "Internal Back-to-Back Differential Input Clamp Diodes Limit Comparator Use" (p.3) and NE5532DR "Internal Back-to-Back Input Clamp Diodes Conduct Above ~0.6 V Differential Input" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose MC33202DR2G when single-supply ADC headroom demands full Rail-to-Rail I/O swing or ultra-low supply current (900 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose NE5532DR when supply rails exceed 12 V (rated up to 30 V) or closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 12 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
